description: Original inputs for SYDE 671 Assignment 2. Custom means independently selected examples, not claims of personal photography. Online examples are usable inputs rather than synthetic placeholders.
archive_note: The user-supplied hybrid ZIP contains Derek, Nutmeg and two MATLAB starter files. The separate Part 2 image ZIP supplied on October 19, 2026 contains the Taj Mahal image, the original Burt-Adelson apple and orange PNGs, and the 1983 reference paper. Taj and all hybrid files are byte-identical to the inputs already used; the wider 740x530 fruit originals replace the earlier 300x300 Berkeley mirror JPEGs for Parts 2.3-2.4.
